owner_instruction_verbatim: Ada gorseli icin referans olarak kullan birebir kullanma arastir düşün bizim oyunumuza uygun olsun
context: Follow-up to the delivered A4 duplex package; owner supplies three island references and asks for an original game-appropriate interpretation. Existing temporary art-direction/visual delegation applies to this requested revision.

chief_editor_implementation_decisions.scope: One original shared island back, six identical instances and replacement sheet 22 in the existing A4 deck.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.visual_direction: Low sandy island, recognizable crooked palms, restrained olive/ochre/slate palette and engraved ink; references guide legibility, never composited or copied.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.orientation: Use one coherent upright island scene, not opposed half-image duplication. This is a delegated composition choice, not a claim that the owner explicitly ordered a symmetry waiver. All six island backs remain identical; no event identity is encoded.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.preserved: All 121 fronts and card text, other six back masters including one upright lighthouse, card sizes, 3 mm bleed, A4 duplex positions, rulebook and print guide.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.delivery: Update full 46-page PDF and provide the changed two-page sheet 22 for people who already printed the prior deck.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.review: Same operator digital image/PDF checks, no claimed independent acceptance, physical printer test, human playtest or release/lock.
